Cambridge Sports Massage Ltd is a well-respected Massage Therapy clinic, With a small team of Therapists and Mike Power as Head Therapist they have huge knowledge of how the body works and responds to the training or events people do. 

The Team works closely with nearly all gyms and fitness trainers in Cambridge which makes their network of professionals a real bonus for clients. Sports Massage and soft tissue treatment is becoming more popular now, as people want to improve the function of their body and recover quicker from training sessions.
